mostWorthwhile.text: The water comparisons were most worthwhile: using the same starting conditions made the channel’s effect on exchange easier to understand without implying that it determines the direction of net movement.

leastWorthwhile.text: Installing each channel and then adding its substance was somewhat repetitive, although the separate steps made the constructions visible.

surprise.text: The lipid-only comparison showed water moving both ways through the membrane, with net movement toward the higher concentration of nonpenetrating solutes.

arbitrary.text: The first attempt felt slightly arbitrary: oxygen seemed relevant to the membrane goal, but water had to be combined with phospholipids first. The compatibility feedback immediately clarified the required assembly.

continue.text: I would choose to continue: the matched membrane comparisons made the physiology concrete, and I would be curious to see how later constructions connect cells to tissues and organs. The picture plans are clear, though this playthrough cannot establish how students would understand them.
